import sys

def next_power_of_two_minus_one(x):
    tmp = 1
    while tmp < x:
        tmp <<= 1
    return tmp - 1

def power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    cur = base
    while exp:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * cur % mod
        cur = cur * cur % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def factorial_init(limit, mod):
    fact = [1] * (limit + 1)
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % mod
    inv_fact = [1] * (limit + 1)
    inv_fact[limit] = power(fact[limit], mod - 2, mod)
    for i in range(limit - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i+1] * (i + 1) % mod
    return fact, inv_fact

def FWT(a, length, helper_row, mod, inverse=False):
    # copy a into helper_row
    for i in range(length):
        helper_row[i] = a[i]
    if inverse:
        step = 1
        while step < length:
            for i in range(0, length, step << 1):
                for j in range(i, i + step):
                    helper_row[j + step] -= helper_row[j]
            step <<= 1
    else:
        step = 1
        while step < length:
            for i in range(0, length, step << 1):
                for j in range(i, i + step):
                    helper_row[j + step] += helper_row[j]
            step <<= 1
    for i in range(length):
        a[i] = helper_row[i] % mod
        if a[i] < 0:
            a[i] += mod

def convolution_with_arr(arr, bucket1, bucket2, bucket3, helper, popcount, size_limit, mod, mod2):
    # reset bucket1 and helper rows
    for j in range(20):
        bucket1[j] = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
        helper[j] = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
    # fill bucket1
    for j in range(size_limit + 1):
        bucket1[popcount[j]][j] = arr[j]
    # FWT each row of bucket1
    for j in range(20):
        FWT(bucket1[j], size_limit + 1, helper[0], mod, False)
    # triple loop
    for q in range(20):
        b1q = bucket1[q]
        for l in range(20 - q):
            b2l = bucket2[l]
            h_ql = helper[q + l]
            for s in range(size_limit + 1):
                val = h_ql[s] + b1q[s] * b2l[s]
                if val >= mod2:
                    val -= mod2
                h_ql[s] = val
    # copy helper to bucket3 with mod
    for q in range(20):
        hq = helper[q]
        b3q = bucket3[q]
        for s in range(size_limit + 1):
            b3q[s] = hq[s] % mod
    # inverse FWT on bucket3
    for j in range(20):
        FWT(bucket3[j], size_limit + 1, helper[0], mod, True)
    # update arr
    for j in range(size_limit + 1):
        arr[j] = bucket3[popcount[j]][j]

def convolution_with_self(bucket2, helper, popcount, size_limit, mod, mod2):
    # reset helper rows
    for i in range(20):
        helper[i] = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
    # triple loop
    for q in range(20):
        b2q = bucket2[q]
        for l in range(20 - q):
            b2l = bucket2[l]
            h_ql = helper[q + l]
            for s in range(size_limit + 1):
                val = h_ql[s] + b2q[s] * b2l[s]
                if val >= mod2:
                    val -= mod2
                h_ql[s] = val
    # create temp and copy with mod
    temp = [[0] * (size_limit + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for q in range(20):
        hq = helper[q]
        tq = temp[q]
        for s in range(size_limit + 1):
            tq[s] = hq[s] % mod
    # inverse FWT on temp
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(temp[i], size_limit + 1, helper[0], mod, True)
    # reset bucket2
    for i in range(20):
        bucket2[i] = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
    # fill bucket2
    for i in range(size_limit + 1):
        pc = popcount[i]
        bucket2[pc][i] = temp[pc][i]
    # FWT on bucket2
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(bucket2[i], size_limit + 1, helper[0], mod, False)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])
    mod2 = p * p
    if n & 1:
        print(power(k, n, p))
        return
    size_limit = next_power_of_two_minus_one(n + 1)
    fact, inv_fact = factorial_init(size_limit, p)
    popcount = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
    for i in range(size_limit + 1):
        popcount[i] = i.bit_count()
    # initialize bucket2
    bucket2 = [[0] * (size_limit + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(size_limit + 1):
        bucket2[popcount[i]][i] = inv_fact[i]
    # helper array (20 rows)
    helper = [[0] * (size_limit + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    # FWT on bucket2
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(bucket2[i], size_limit + 1, helper[0], p, False)
    # arr
    arr = [0] * (size_limit + 1)
    arr[0] = 1
    bucket1 = [[0] * (size_limit + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    bucket3 = [[0] * (size_limit + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    original_k = k
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            convolution_with_arr(arr, bucket1, bucket2, bucket3, helper, popcount, size_limit, p, mod2)
        k >>= 1
        if k:
            convolution_with_self(bucket2, helper, popcount, size_limit, p, mod2)
    result = (power(original_k, n, p) - fact[n] * arr[n] % p + p) % p
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
